QuestInfo.name: The Strange Beast
QuestInfo.0: Now that you have reached Lv. 30, #b#p2151000##k is calling you.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the #r#o9001036##k that has terrorizing Edelstein. It was last seen near the fountain at #m310020100#.
QuestInfo.2: #r#o9001036##k claims that it is really #b#p2151009##k. Maybe you should hear it out.

0.0: Hey, #h0#. You've been tearing it up, huh? The whole Resistance is talking about your skills.
0.1: See, you're the kind of person we need to take care of the #r#o9001036##k. This thing's been appearing outside the city randomly, scaring people and vanishing.

yes.0: All right. The last sighting was near the fountain at #m310020100#, so I suggest starting there.

no.0: Well, I sure thought you would be interested in a challenge. Suppose I was wrong...but if you change your mind, come on back.

1.0: Wait, you can...! C-commander? It...it really is you, Commander #h0#! Oh, no, wait, wait! It's me, #p2151009#!
1.1: An impostor? Me? How could you even... Oh, right, I'm a cat. I keep forgetting that. Here, lower your weapon, and I'll explain everything.

yes.0: Let me just say...it's such a relief to see you again, #h0#... I knew the Black Mage couldn't beat you. As for me...it happened the day I left #m270000100# to deliver the letter to the heroes. You see, I actually found them!
yes.1: The heroes were on their way to fight the Black Mage. I was about to give them the letter, when #p2159308# appeared and attacked me! He wounded me terribly...so badly, that all I could do was change into this form to survive.
yes.2: Since then, I've been wandering the world, searching for you, #h0#. I have almost no powers in this form...it's been difficult.

npc.0: Start by checking the fountain at #m310020100#. You found the Black Wing Spy, so I imagine this should be no problem for you.

mob.0: Meow! Meow, meow! Meow? Meow meow.
